annotations.title: Every branch in me.
annotations.text: By this it appeareth that Chriſt hath ſome branches in his body myſtical that be fruitleſs: therefore ill livers alſo may be members of Chriſt and the Church, though none can be ſaved but fruitful branches.

annotations.title: More fruit.
annotations.text: This proveth that a juſt man may continually increaſe in juſtice & ſanctification ſo long as he liveth.

annotations.title: Vnles it abide.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Whoſoeuer by Hereſie or Schiſme or for any other cauſe is cut of or ſeparated from the Church, he can do no meritorious worke to Saluation.

notes.text: No salvation out of the Church.

annotations.title: Vnles you abide.
annotations.text: ◦ Theſe conditional ſpeaches, If you remaine in the vine, If you keepe my commaundements, and ſuch like, giue vs to wit that we be not ſure to perſiſt or perſeuêre, nor to be ſaued, but vnder conditions to be fulfilled by vs. Aug. de corrept. & gra. c. 13.

annotations.title: Keepe my praecepts.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> This careful and often admonition of keeping his commaundements, proueth that a Chriſtian mans life is not onely or principally in faith, but in good workes.

notes.text: Only faith sufficeth not to salvation.

annotations.title: If I had.
annotations.text: If the Iewes had not ſinned by refuſing Chriſt, in caſe he had not done greater miracles then any other: then were it a great folly of Catholikes to beleeue Luthers or Caluins new opinions without any miracles at all.

annotations.title: Whom I vvil ſend.
annotations.text: The Holy Ghoſt is ſent by the Sonne, therfore he procedeth from him alſo, as from the Father: though the late Schiſmatical Greekes thinke otherwiſe.

annotations.title: You ſhal giue.
annotations.text: He vouchſafeth to ioyne together the teſtimonie of the Holy Ghoſt, and of the Apoſtles: that we may ſee the teſtimonie of truth ioyntly to conſiſt in the Holy Ghoſt and in the Prelats of the Church.
